fact_previews: The NoCO2 mobile app tracks a person's CO2 emissions and allows users to offset them with integrated payments to carbon offset providers.
The app forecasts CO2 emissions based on housing, consumption habits, mode of transportation, and trip distances.
The app tracks trip distances automatically using changes in the smartphone's GPS coordinates.
Users can offset between 0% to 100% of their CO2 emissions through the app.
The app integrates payments to carbon offset providers such as bullfrogpower.com and carbonfund.org.

fact_previews: The NoCO2 mobile app tracks changes in the smartphone's GPS coordinates to question users about their travel habits after each trip.
Users of the NoCO2 app can offset some or all of their CO2 emissions through integrated payments to carbon offset providers like bullfrogpower.com or carbonfund.org.
The NoCO2 web platform will have an open API for third parties, including government, stores, or companies, to integrate with the app.
Third parties can reward users for low CO2 emissions by matching their contributions to offset providers or green mutual funds.
The platform allows third parties to upload data on CO2 emissions from vehicles, houses, or products throughout their life cycle.
